title: Eugene, 4 AM
logline: The Greyhound station in Eugene at 4 AM, drawn from nothing — he was never there. Fluorescent light, a vending machine, one bench, a bag with a strap. The bus outside with its door open. The road she took, page by page.

panels.composition: A bus station interior at 4 AM: fluorescent tubes, a vending machine's glow, a scuffed floor, one bench with a duffel on it — the strap the strip drew in 1999 — and through the glass, the bus with its door open and its interior lights on, empty. No people. Everything slightly wrong in the way of a place drawn from a schedule.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bus station interior at 4 AM lit by fluorescent tubes and a glowing vending machine, one bench with a duffel bag on it, and through the glass a bus with its door open and interior lights on and no one aboard, no people anywhere, no words
image.notes: The duffel is the 1999 one (dw_1999 Seattle, Said). Drawn from nothing: get small details plausibly wrong on purpose (a sign in the wrong font).

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
